transcript: Let me explain what a price to earnings ratio is. A P/E of 20 means that you are paying 20 dollars for every dollar of earnings. Historically the S&P 500 has returned about 10 percent per year, and in 2022 it fell about 19 percent. For example, imagine a company earning 5 dollars per share trading at 100 dollars. That is a P/E of 20. Thanks for watching.
